data.one_liner: Audio record plugin supporting record, pause, resume, stop, and level metering.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to record audio on Android and iOS devices. It supports audio formats like AAC and WAV, and exposes audio level metering properties such as average power and peak power.
use_when: You need to record audio inside a Flutter mobile application on Android and iOS.
You need access to audio level metering properties like peak power and average power during recording.
avoid_when: You are building for desktop or web platforms, as they are not documented or supported by this plugin.
You only need to play audio rather than record it.
strengths: Supports core recording controls: record, pause, resume, and stop.
Provides audio level metering (average and peak power).
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
Requires manual platform-specific configuration and permission setups in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSMicrophoneUsageDescription in iOS Info.plist and RECORD_AUDIO / WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: A modern, well-maintained package for recording audio across multiple platforms.
